decision: PASS: DIRgate2→3 and TXgate1→4 use equivalent active gates; unusedgate1disabled and unusedgate2enabledconstantLOW withNCoutput.
scope: Read-only datasheet/local-net review. No PCB, schematic, routing, model, GPIO, BOM or Stage edits made.

support: Section6/Table3 non-inverting active-LOW enable truth table
DE activeHIGH; RE_N activeLOW; same DIR tied to both gives receive mode atLOW

part.domain: MAIN common ground, same local3.3V rail as U11 logic; U13 is not a galvanic barrier.

DIR.downstream: R48=22R to /RS485_DIR then U11.4 RE_N and U11.5 DE

functional_contract.unused_gates: Gate1: OE1 to localVCC, A2 toGND, Y3 explicitlyNC. Gate2: OE4 toGND, A5 toGND, Y6 explicitlyNC; enabled staticLOW with no output load. Every A/OE input is defined.
functional_contract.Ioff: Unchanged device feature at VCC=0; bounded leakage, not ideal zero current. Pin permutation does not change it.
functional_contract.power_domain: No MAIN↔FIELD reassignment. U14 RX buffer, U11 barrier, decoupling, R47/R48 and external pull resistors remain unchanged.

default_states.condition: Both3.3V rails valid, MCU GPIOs high-Z

default_states.buffer_outputs: Ioff power-off state; external post-buffer bias only acts if its rail is valid. No claim about supply ramp logic.

default_states.TX: R50 is tied to an unpowered rail, so HIGH is not guaranteed. This already applies before the swap.
default_states.DIR: R51/R55 retain the low default; under high-Z GPIO assumptions DE stays disabled.

implementation_checks_for_parent: Update U13 schematic bindings, PCB pad nets, affected copper and literal14-pin assertions together.
Retire old enabled-gate source/output copper before tying former inputs/OEs to their new rails.
Unused Y pins get explicit schematic no-connect markers; gate1OE=VCC/A=GND; gate2OE=GND/A=GND. Do not leave A or OE floating.
Keep R50 pull-up and R51 pull-down on the same logical GPIO nets and keep R54/R55 after-buffer bias.
Verify enabled paths A→Y and the commonGND/VCC pins after netlist regeneration.
Native copper, boot behavior during rail ramps, EMC and physical routing remain separate checks.

numerical_datasheet_context.note: These are unchanged component limits, not a new circuit-level zero-leakage or ramp guarantee.
